lema: the man who drew a rhino he never saw
tema: Albrecht Dürer: the rhino he never saw, his AD logo and the first fight over a copied logo

lineas.texto: The most famous rhino in art history was drawn by a guy who never saw a rhino.
lineas.tts: The most famous rhino in art history... was drawn by a guy who never saw a rhino. [laughs]
lineas.accion: she leans in with a scandalised grin, eyes dart left and right as if sharing gossip, then eyebrows shoot up and she snorts a laugh on 'never saw a rhino'. She keeps her face toward the lens for the punchline. No hands, no body.

lineas.texto: Albrecht Dürer. Nuremberg, Germany, around 1500. Yes, that's his selfie.
lineas.tts: [playful] Albrecht Dürer. Nuremberg, Germany, around 1500. [giggles] Yes... that's his selfie.

lineas.texto: Look closely at the rhino. Armor plates, scaly legs, and a tiny extra horn on its back.
lineas.tts: Look closely at the rhino. Armor plates, scaly legs... and a tiny extra horn on its back.
lineas.accion: she squints one eye and pushes toward the lens as if through a magnifying glass on 'look closely', eyes snap wide on 'armor plates', then a slow smirk on 'extra horn'. She keeps her face toward the lens for the punchline. No hands, no body.

lineas.texto: In 1515 a real rhino reached Lisbon. Dürer only got a letter and a sketch. His version stayed in school books for four hundred years.
lineas.tts: [excited] In 1515 a real rhino reached Lisbon. [sarcastic] Dürer only got a letter... and a sketch. [impressed] His version stayed in school books for four hundred years.

lineas.texto: And here's the thing: he was a total brand. He signed everything with his AD logo.
lineas.tts: And here's the thing: he was a total brand. He signed everything with his A, D logo.
lineas.accion: one eyebrow up and a slight lean in on 'here's the thing', an exaggerated proud nod on 'total brand', a wink on 'logo'. She keeps her face toward the lens for the punchline. No hands, no body.

lineas.texto: Art is hidden in nature. Whoever can tear it out, has it.
lineas.tts: [dramatic] Art is hidden in nature. [whispers] Whoever can tear it out... has it.

lineas.texto: When a printer in Venice copied his prints, logo and all, Dürer went to the government. They protected the logo.
lineas.tts: [gossipy] When a printer in Venice copied his prints, logo and all... [dramatic] Dürer went to the government. [smug] They protected the logo.

lineas.texto: So scholars still argue. Was he a scientist, or the first artist influencer?
lineas.tts: So scholars still argue. Was he a scientist... or the first artist influencer?
lineas.accion: her head tilts to one side on 'scientist', then swings to the other side with a mocking pout on 'influencer'. She keeps her face toward the lens for the punchline. No hands, no body.

lineas.texto: He painted a hare so real you can count the hairs, and a rhino he made up.
lineas.tts: [amazed] He painted a hare so real you can count the hairs... [laughs] and a rhino he made up.

lineas.texto: Genius or hype man? Tell me in the comments. I'm off to draw a rhino from memory.
lineas.tts: Genius... or hype man? Tell me in the comments. [laughs] I'm off to draw a rhino from memory.
lineas.accion: eyes roll up thinking on 'genius', a sly side glance on 'hype man', back to the lens on 'tell me in the comments', and a wink with a laugh at the end. She keeps her face toward the lens for the punchline. No hands, no body.

continuacion.L10: she keeps the closed-mouth smug smile toward the lens, gives a tiny proud head tilt, then a slow playful wink, and settles back to a satisfied smile looking straight at the camera
